//: Copy this file to appsettings.Local.json (same folder) and fill in the client id and secret. appsettings.Local.json is gitignored and excluded from publish, so a real secret there travels with neither the source nor a deployment. Restart the API after editing - configuration is read at startup.
//app: Register the app at https://developer.atlassian.com/console/myapps/ with an ACCOUNT-LEVEL grant, so one sign-in can reach both tenants. Add the callback URL below to it verbatim, and grant the classic scopes read:jira-work, write:jira-work, read:jira-user AND the granular Jira Software scopes read:sprint:jira-software, read:board-scope:jira-software - the classic ones do not cover sprints.
//tokens: There is no Credentials section. The tool stores no Atlassian API token and takes none on request headers: signing in is the only way to reach a tenant.
